title: Weakly associated primes contract along a finite ring map
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings such that $S$ is generated by finitely many elements as an $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Let $P$ be any $S$-module, regarded as an $R$-module by $r x=\varphi(r)x$. For a commutative ring $T$ and a $T$-module $N$, let $\operatorname{WeakAss}_T(N)$ be the set of prime ideals minimal among the prime ideals containing $\operatorname{Ann}_T(x)=\{t\in T:tx=0\}$ for some $x\in N$. If $\mathfrak q\in\operatorname{WeakAss}_S(P)$, then $\varphi^{-1}(\mathfrak q)\in\operatorname{WeakAss}_R(P)$. There is no Noetherian hypothesis on the rings and no finite-generation hypothesis on $P$.
